issues.on_page: Statement of Activities (p2): Scholarships and financial aid operating grants and contributions 24,943; Investment interest - restricted 29,728 = Special Building 21,132 + Bond 6,576 + Nutrition 247 + 1,773 (Permanent Fund). 24,943 + 1,773 = 26,716
issues.issue: [fixed] The Bluejay Foundation local receipts are explained in the report: 24,943 are contributions (over half of the line) and 1,773 is interest. The line should be donations/contributions, not other. The p2 breakdown would also support splitting it into 24,943 donations/contributions and 1,773 investment income. Leaving it as is also understates investment income (receipts[6] 151,682 vs printed interest 29,728 + 123,727 = 153,455).
Scholarships paid by the foundation are not really instruction. This is a judgment call (another option is other with a review flag), and the extractor already flagged it for review.

issues.on_page: Debt service interest 247,225 + Other miscellaneous expenses 400
issues.issue: The Bond Fund line 'Other miscellaneous expenses' 400 is assumed to be debt fees and folded into debt service interest (also detail[98]). It is defensible but not stated on the page.

issues.on_page: Statement p5/p6: School Nutrition column puts 107,382 in Student meals and 86,592 in Federal programs
issues.issue: The statement splits School Nutrition spending between two functions, but the detail lines carry only food service, so the detail function split won't tie to the statement for 86,592. This is a judgment call because the fund schedule gives no function breakdown.
